craft_claim: Absorption into a dramatized instance increases story-consistent belief and reduces counterarguing, so an inspirational passage persuades better as a scene or testimony than as a slogan.

supporting_evidence.location: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology 79(5):701-721, Experiments 1-4
supporting_evidence.note: Greater transportation augmented story-consistent beliefs and favourable protagonist evaluations; highly transported readers found fewer false notes, and transportation effects were generally unaffected by labelling a story as fact or fiction.
Tagore's songs build devotional longing through a single natural image per poem rather than doctrinal assertion, an instance-first structure consistent with transportational persuasion.

counterevidence.note: Transportation is a continuum and can be reduced by intrusive narration or clashing stylistic signals, which weakens the effect.

scope: Narrative, testimony, and illustrative prose; weaker in pure abstraction or bullet-point copy.
exceptions: Stated-preference or technical writing where the reader expects argument over absorption.
